rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The party organ reports that on the 30th 公明党 held its sixth national convention and elected 太田昭宏新代表: under rule 20, 太田幹事長代行, confirmed as the only candidate, received the confidence of all delegates present standing and was elected new representative ('出席代議員の起立総員による信任を受け、新代表に選出された').
